title: I guess we'll never know
technique: Plain written prompt: cast and rooms from reference images, every camera move described in words; only video sent is the end screen.
story: A cat lady sits on her sofa at night; candles burn all over her apartment, her cat beside her.
She scrolls the Fig & Cedar product page up and down, searching. She does not buy.
Inner voice, lips closed, the camera circling her: Are these safe for cats?
She finds nothing, gets annoyed (shown only), closes the site: I guess we'll never know.
The High flip drops to the owner reading her sales: I guess no one's interested in Fig and Cedar. No one wants this. Time to discontinue the product line. She blows out the candle.
Scout: Don't guess why your shoppers don't buy. End screen: Scout interviews your shoppers for you. Get free early access.
